# Original C-locale oracle functions from ef6efc6bb.
# Test data, sourced ONLY by a shell started with LC_ALL=C.

_gr_json_str() {
  local LC_ALL=C s=$1 out='' c i
  s=${s//\\/\\\\}
  s=${s//\"/\\\"}
  case $s in
    *[$'\001'-$'\037'$'\177']*)
      for ((i = 0; i < ${#s}; i++)); do
        c=${s:i:1}
        case $c in
          $'\b') out="$out\\b" ;;
          $'\t') out="$out\\t" ;;
          $'\n') out="$out\\n" ;;
          $'\f') out="$out\\f" ;;
          $'\r') out="$out\\r" ;;
          [$'\001'-$'\037'$'\177']) printf -v c '\\u%04x' "'$c"; out="$out$c" ;;
          *) out="$out$c" ;;
        esac
      done
      s=$out
      ;;
  esac
  GR_JSON="\"$s\""
}

_gr_trellis_home() {
  GR_TRELLIS_HOME=${TRELLIS_HOME:-}
  [ -n "$GR_TRELLIS_HOME" ] || { [ -z "${HOME:-}" ] || GR_TRELLIS_HOME=${HOME%/}/.trellis; }
}

_gr_reread_override_active() {
  local key=$1 file line extra="" expires created reason rest field LC_ALL=C
  case $key in ''|*[!0-9a-f]*) return 1 ;; esac
  [ "${#key}" -eq 16 ] || return 1
  _gr_trellis_home
  [ -n "$GR_TRELLIS_HOME" ] || return 1
  file=$GR_TRELLIS_HOME/state/reread-overrides/$key
  [ -f "$file" ] && [ ! -L "$file" ] || return 1
  { IFS= read -r line && ! IFS= read -r extra; } < "$file" 2>/dev/null || return 1
  [ -z "$extra" ] && [ "${#line}" -le 4095 ] || return 1
  case $line in *$'\t'*$'\t'*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  expires=${line%%$'\t'*} rest=${line#*$'\t'}
  created=${rest%%$'\t'*} reason=${rest#*$'\t'}
  for field in "$expires" "$created"; do
    case $field in ''|0*|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
    [ "${#field}" -le 12 ] || return 1
  done
  case $reason in ''|*[[:cntrl:]]*) return 1 ;; esac
  [ "${#reason}" -le 2000 ] || return 1
  [ $((created + GR_REREAD_OVERRIDE_TTL)) -eq "$expires" ] || return 1
  _gr_now
  case $GR_NOW in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
  [ "$expires" -gt "$GR_NOW" ] && [ $((expires - GR_NOW)) -le "$GR_REREAD_OVERRIDE_TTL" ]
}

_attachment_visible() {
  local LC_ALL=C value=$1 out='' char i
  case "$value" in
    *[[:cntrl:]]*) ;;
    *) printf '%s' "$value"; return 0 ;;
  esac
  for ((i = 0; i < ${#value}; i++)); do
    char=${value:i:1}
    case "$char" in
      $'\n') out+='\n' ;;
      $'\r') out+='\r' ;;
      $'\t') out+='\t' ;;
      [[:cntrl:]]) out+=$(printf '\\x%02x' "'$char") ;;
      *) out+=$char ;;
    esac
  done
  printf '%s' "$out"
}

_attachment_hooks_expected_passthrough_names() {
  local root=${1:-} previous=${2:-} payload=${3:-} dir="" entry base regular=false seen=false
  local LC_ALL=C
  case "$previous" in
    "")
      [ -n "$root" ] || return 0
      [ -z "$payload" ] || _attachment_hooks_payload_shims_default "$payload" || return 0
      dir=$(_attachment_hooks_default_hooks_dir "$root") || return 1
      [ ! -L "$dir" ] || return 0
      regular=true
      ;;
    /*) dir="$previous" ;;
    *)
      [ -n "$root" ] || return 0
      dir="$root/$previous"
      ;;
  esac
  # A readable, searchable, nonempty directory is the normal case. Bash's C
  # locale glob is already sorted, and hook names never begin with a dot. If
  # the glob finds no entries, it may be empty or a failed enumeration: ask
  # the slow scanner rather than treating that ambiguity as proof of absence.
  if [ -d "$dir" ] && [ -r "$dir" ] && [ -x "$dir" ]; then
    for entry in "$dir"/?* "$dir"/.[!.]* "$dir"/..?*; do
      [ -e "$entry" ] || [ -L "$entry" ] || continue
      seen=true
      base=${entry##*/}
      _attachment_hooks_is_passthrough_name "$base" || continue
      if [ "$regular" = true ] && [ -L "$entry" ]; then
        continue
      fi
      if { [ -f "$entry" ] || [ -L "$entry" ]; } && [ -x "$entry" ]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$base"
      fi
    done
    [ "$seen" = false ] || return 0
  fi
  _attachment_hooks_expected_passthrough_names_slow "$dir" "$regular"
}

shared_infra_safe_line() {
  local LC_ALL=C value="${1:-}"
  case "$value" in
    *[$'\001'-$'\037'$'\177']*|*$'\302'[$'\200'-$'\237']*)
      printf '<unsafe tool diagnostic>' ;;
    *) printf '%s' "$value" ;;
  esac
}

pg_audit_dir_values() {
  local LC_ALL=C line key val
  local re_assign='^(SECURITY_GATE_[A-Z0-9_]+|LLM_[A-Z0-9_]+)=(.*)$'
  local re_tail='([[:space:]]+(#.*)?)?$'
  local re_dq='^"([^"$`\\]*)"'"$re_tail"
  local re_sq="^'([^']*)'$re_tail"
  local re_bare='^([A-Za-z0-9_./:,@+%=-]*)'"$re_tail"
  local re_def='^"[$][{]([A-Z0-9_]+):-([^"$`\\}]*)[}]"'"$re_tail"
  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    line="${line#"${line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    case "$line" in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
    [[ "$line" =~ $re_assign ]] || return 1
    key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" val="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    if [[ "$val" =~ $re_def ]]; then
      [ "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" = "$key" ] || return 1
      val="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    elif [[ "$val" =~ $re_dq ]] || [[ "$val" =~ $re_sq ]] || [[ "$val" =~ $re_bare ]]; then
      val="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    else
      return 1
    fi
    [ "$key" != SECURITY_GATE_AUDIT_DIR ] || printf '%s\n' "$val"
  done
}

resolve_analyze_report() {
  local spec_dir="$1"
  local selected=""
  local highest_round="0"
  local candidate name suffix round
  local LC_ALL=C

  if [ -f "$spec_dir/analyze.md" ]; then
    selected="$spec_dir/analyze.md"
    highest_round="1"
  fi

  for candidate in "$spec_dir"/analyze-*.md; do
    [ -f "$candidate" ] || continue
    name="${candidate##*/}"
    suffix="${name#analyze-}"
    suffix="${suffix%.md}"
    case "$suffix" in
      ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;;
    esac

    round="$suffix"
    while [ "${round#0}" != "$round" ]; do
      round="${round#0}"
    done
    [ -n "$round" ] || round="0"

    # Equal-length normalized digit strings compare lexically without integer overflow.
    # shellcheck disable=SC2071
    if [ "${#round}" -gt "${#highest_round}" ] \
      || { [ "${#round}" -eq "${#highest_round}" ] && [[ "$round" > "$highest_round" ]]; }; then
      selected="$candidate"
      highest_round="$round"
    fi
  done

  [ -n "$selected" ] && printf '%s\n' "$selected"
}

sg_parse_local_config() {
  local LC_ALL=C line key val n=0
  local re_assign='^([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)=(.*)$'
  local re_tail='([[:space:]]+(#.*)?)?$'
  local re_dq='^"([^"$`\\]*)"'"$re_tail"
  local re_sq="^'([^']*)'$re_tail"
  local re_bare='^([A-Za-z0-9_./:,@+%=-]*)'"$re_tail"
  local re_def='^"[$][{]([A-Z0-9_]+):-([^"$`\\}]*)[}]"'"$re_tail"
  SG_CONFIG_BAD_LINE=0
  while IFS= builtin read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    line="${line#"${line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    case "$line" in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
    SG_CONFIG_BAD_LINE="$n"
    [[ "$line" =~ $re_assign ]] || return 1
    key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"; val="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    case "$key" in
      SECURITY_GATE_STACK_PROFILE|SECURITY_GATE_PROJECT_NAME|SECURITY_GATE_AUDIT_DIR|\
      SECURITY_GATE_SEMGREP_TIMEOUT|SECURITY_GATE_SHELLCHECK|SECURITY_GATE_SHELLCHECK_EXCLUDE_GLOBS|\
      SECURITY_GATE_GARAK_TARGET|SECURITY_GATE_GARAK_PROBES|SECURITY_GATE_GARAK_TIMEOUT|\
      SECURITY_GATE_LLM_TIMEOUT_S|SECURITY_GATE_STACK_VALIDATORS|LLM_PROVIDER|LLM_MODEL) ;;
      *) return 1 ;;
    esac
    if [[ "$val" =~ $re_def ]]; then
      [ "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" = "$key" ] || return 1
      [ -n "${!key:-}" ] || builtin printf -v "$key" '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    elif [[ "$val" =~ $re_dq ]] || [[ "$val" =~ $re_sq ]] || [[ "$val" =~ $re_bare ]]; then
      builtin printf -v "$key" '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    else
      return 1
    fi
    builtin export "${key?}"
  done < "$1"
  # shellcheck disable=SC2034  # consumed by the calling baseline
  SG_CONFIG_BAD_LINE=0
}

parse_config_data() {
  # Byte semantics: `[A-Z]` is ASCII only, and a non-ASCII key never matches.
  local LC_ALL=C
  local line key val n=0
  local re_assign='^(SECURITY_GATE_[A-Z0-9_]+|LLM_[A-Z0-9_]+)=(.*)$'
  # [[:space:]] includes CR, so a CRLF file parses the same as an LF one.
  local re_tail='([[:space:]]+(#.*)?)?$'
  local re_dq='^"([^"$`\\]*)"'"$re_tail"
  local re_sq="^'([^']*)'$re_tail"
  local re_bare='^([A-Za-z0-9_./:,@+%=-]*)'"$re_tail"
  local re_def='^"[$][{]([A-Z0-9_]+):-([^"$`\\}]*)[}]"'"$re_tail"
  while IFS= builtin read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    line="${line#"${line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    case "$line" in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
    CONFIG_BAD_LINE="$n"
    [[ "$line" =~ $re_assign ]] || return 1
    key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"; val="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    # A repeated key is last-wins, as it was when the file was sourced.
    if [[ "$val" =~ $re_def ]]; then
      [ "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" = "$key" ] || return 1
      case "$key" in SECURITY_GATE_*) [ -n "${!key:-}" ] || builtin printf -v "$key" '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}" ;; esac
    elif [[ "$val" =~ $re_dq ]] || [[ "$val" =~ $re_sq ]] || [[ "$val" =~ $re_bare ]]; then
      case "$key" in SECURITY_GATE_*) builtin printf -v "$key" '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" ;; esac
    else
      return 1
    fi
  done < "$1"
  CONFIG_BAD_LINE=0
}
